questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84fb3279d9acec11c56b74aae9bb81440bdbfbfb118ccfe5281b2ea16efb26b4.png]
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:-

From the given three different cubes, figure 1 and figure 3, the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 1 is common in both figure 1 and figure 2, it is clear that 3, 4, 5 and 6 are adjacent to it, and the remaining number i.e., 2 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7606d79a9343cb680f9a78347d24c6448e38dd206008645c90af493b091ef0a1.png] 

Opposite pairs:

3 → 5

4 → 6

1 → 2

So, the opposite side of "1" will be side "2".

Hence, the correct answer is "2".

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some P are K.

II. No K is T.

**Conclusions:**

I. All P are T.

II. All T are K.

III. Some P are not T.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a44a24d4df7e02ac03e75d92704f63ba93bb1b4f1f240319628eb0ff0cfd04d8.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All P are T → Does not follow (As some P are K and no K is T. So, some P's part comes in K which has direct negative or cross relation with T therefore it is definitely false)

II. All T are K → Does not follow (As no K is T. So, a direct negative or cross relation is given between K and T therefore it is definitely false)

III. Some P are not T → Follow (As some P are K and no K is T. So, some P's part comes in K which has direct negative or cross relation with T therefore it is definitely true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion III follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion III follows**"

Symbol

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
× 

 
 
 
+

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Mother

to T

 
 
 

So,

 
• Option - (1) : Q - P + R → Q is the mother of P who is the sister of R.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21a987d8c04e39f665562ab86396431f8d40494a9196e6984de2bb8aa7be9078.png] 

Here, P is the sister of R.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04d22a998b5429a9f38c47b3e4cb71797d7942e8295fce3cdb9826639c84d4ab.png] 

**Here, P is the mother of R.**

Here, P is the father of R.

 
• Option - (4) : R + Q - P → R is the sister of Q who is the mother of P.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a218efbc8e60ed9fba162bbd1aa3ba9258169b540a1512c6142ce57aab25299.png] 

Here, P is either niece or nephew of R.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word.)

Flock : Birds :: Swarm : ?
questions.solution:
In the given analogy, "Flock" is related to "Birds" because a flock is a group of birds.

Similarly, "Swarm" is related to "Bees" because a swarm is a group of bees.

The relationship is based on the fact that both pairs represent groups of specific types of animals.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2 - Bees.**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth term in the same way as the first term is related to the second term and the fifth term is related to the sixth term.

8 : 48 :: ? : 143 :: 15 : 195
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is : 1st number × (1number - 2) = 2nd number

So,

__
 
• 8 : 48

​8 × **(8 - 2)**__ = 48

__**8 × 6**__ = 48

48 = 48 (LHS = RHS)

And,

__
 
• 15 : 195​

​15 × **(15 - 2)**__ = 195

__**15 × 13**__ = 195

195 = 195 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 
• ? : 143​

​Let '?' be 'x'

​x × (x - 2) = 143

x2 - 2x = 143

x2 - 2x - 143 = 0 

(x - 13) (x + 11) = 0

x = either 13 or (-11)

As, the answer cannot be negative, therefore value of x will be 13.

Hence, "13" is the correct answer.
